identity.title: Polygon RPC Transport Compatibility + Failure-Classification Repair
identity.objective: Repair the WP169 Polygon public RPC production transport so it uses the already-certified fixed User-Agent and preserves HTTP responses for existing non-2xx handling instead of collapsing HTTPError into NETWORK_TIMEOUT, without changing provider authority, RPC methods, credentials, trading authority, or live/economic behavior. Triggered by S10-DEPLOY-EXEC-01 Phase B on the deployed cb82114 release: a direct eth_chainId request from the same host returned HTTP 200 / 0x89, while the canonical urllib smoke failed twice with an immediate NETWORK_TIMEOUT and zero Polygon raw rows; the other public HTTP and WebSocket surfaces were healthy. Phase B stays suspended.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-DEPLOY-EXEC-01R2. The Polygon default RPC transport returns to sending no explicit User-Agent and mapping every urllib exception (including HTTPError) to NETWORK_TIMEOUT; the regression tests and repair status/spec artifacts disappear. The provider allowlist, RPC method allowlist, store, runtime, runner, deployment tooling, dependencies and workflows are untouched; no host, store, order or capital state is touched.

api_matrix.reason: Private default transport behavior only; no public function signature, CLI, store or receipt field changes.

semantic_fields.reason: These rules close the repaired Polygon default RPC transport headers, its HTTP-versus-transport failure classification and the unchanged provider/method/authority posture.

items.required_rule: The default Polygon RPC transport sends POST with exactly Content-Type: application/json, Accept: application/json and User-Agent: wp169-public-market-truth/1.0; no caller-supplied, environment-derived, credential, cookie or authorization header; the body is exactly the caller JSON-RPC body.
items.validation_rule: Behavioral test intercepts urllib.request.urlopen and inspects the real Request object and the transport signature.
items.safe_output: closed acquisition receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: urllib HTTPError is returned as (status, headers, body) so the existing _rpc_call non-2xx rule yields RESPONSE_INVALID; HTTP 403/429/5xx are never NETWORK_TIMEOUT and a non-2xx body is never accepted as JSON-RPC success.
items.validation_rule: Behavioral tests with real urllib.error.HTTPError objects through the transport, _rpc_call and the collection path.
items.safe_output: closed acquisition receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: Genuine non-HTTP transport failures (DNS, connect, TLS, socket timeout, other urlopen exception) remain NETWORK_TIMEOUT; no retry, redirect or fallback logic is added.
items.validation_rule: Behavioral tests with URLError, TimeoutError, socket.timeout, ssl.SSLError and OSError.
items.safe_output: closed acquisition receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: The provider allowlist stays drpc -> https://polygon.drpc.org only and the JSON-RPC method allowlist stays eth_chainId, eth_blockNumber, eth_getLogs, eth_getBlockByNumber; any other provider or method is RPC_PROVIDER_FORBIDDEN before any transport call.
items.validation_rule: Behavioral test of validate_public_rpc_url and _rpc_call with a transport-call counter.
items.safe_output: closed acquisition receipt status or closed error_code

items.required_rule: No VPS mutation, diagnostic, smoke, mixed window, backup, restore or reboot; no credential, account, signing, order, capital, live, workflow, dependency, store, runtime, runner or deployment-tooling change; no real network call in tests; Phase B stays suspended until merge and fresh authorization.
items.validation_rule: Exact five-path diff; authority mirror; socket guard in tests; status entry.
items.safe_output: closed acquisition receipt status or closed error_code
